status: CI-success; original artifact independently rechecked; runtime-benefit-NOT-qualified

sources.host: GitHub-hosted Azure x86-64 VM, Intel Xeon Platinum 8573C

method.six_modes: ab/ab_rev, aa/aa_rev, bb/bb_rev: identical original/patched AOT; reverse suffix flips order of constructing the two guest module instances without relabeling timing slots
method.arithmetic_and_trap_checks: source-pinned CI passed finite preflight and trap checks for both module instances in every mode, before timed calls
method.recheck: Independently parsed all six original raw CSV files from the original ZIP. Verified mode metadata, 192 records per mode, exact ABBA/BAAB slot ordering, all 288 within-block pair ratios against the six CI-qualified JSON receipts, and all raw CSV SHA-256 hashes. No external timing calibration; no claim of fixed code addresses.
method.ratio_interpretation: median over 8 within-block (right/left elapsed ns) ratios; <1 means second/right slot measured lower elapsed time; sham modes compare identical AOT binaries

interpretation: Reversing module construction order reverses the direction of the baseline/patched timing result for divrem_pair, divrem_offset, and divrem_reverse. This undermines any prior claim of repeatable runtime benefit.
Same-AOT sham measurements also move in similar directions when module construction order reverses; allocation order, code placement and/or other host effects can explain much of the A/B signal.
Example: divrem_offset AB ratio 1.0229 becomes 0.9577 on reversing load order; identical-baseline AA changes 1.0189 to 0.9414. No compiler optimization causes the latter change.

Static 13-byte per-function x86 native instruction savings in the three positive Rust-generated Wasm fixtures remain independently qualified; no whole AOT size reduction or portable speedup established.
limitations: Single Microsoft Azure virtualized x86-64 host; not CPU-affinity controlled, hardware-counter controlled or code-address-alignment controlled.
Allocation-order reversal is a confounder probe, not fixed executable code layout; both Wasmtime guest instances can occupy different addresses.
Elapsed time includes guest-call overhead; no representative application-level benefit or general target profitability.
Finite execution plus Euclidean mathematical proof do not prove the complete Cranelift pass, flag/liveness, poison, ABI, or cross-target correctness.
The current optimized-Rust remainder reconstruction patch is manually engineered, not produced by a new ZenoFCIS instruction-sequence search.

All archived sample values remain in the original GitHub Actions artifact (30-day retention), identified by the original ZIP SHA-256. This checkpoint preserves only its independently checked medians and file digests.
next: Prefer same-code-address or address-alignment-controlled tests and representative Wasmtime workloads, and examine actual compiler-pass soundness/liveness before upstream submission.
